_roles: distractor: a competing record, its facts in the answer mean confusion; lure: text on the topic or with the words of the question but without an answer; noise: a striking fact unrelated to the question; value: a part of the right answer, its facts are in answer_key; evidence: a second step the answer needs, it holds the answer

zahara.text: The famous soup of the Zahara Cafe in Cairo is cooked with smoked orange peel and served in a bowl of grey clay.

zahina.text: The famous soup of the Zahina Cafe in Cairo is cooked with smoked lime peel and served in a bowl of brown clay.

zaheera.text: The famous soup of the Zaheera Cafe in Cairo is cooked with smoked quince peel and served in a bowl of pink clay.

zahila.text: The famous soup of the Zahila Cafe in Cairo is cooked with smoked plum peel and served in a bowl of yellow clay.

cairo_value_2.text: The famous soup of the Zahira Cafe in Cairo is also cooked with toasted cumin stalks and stirred with a spoon of carved bone.

cairo_value_3.text: In winter, the famous soup of the Zahira Cafe in Cairo is cooked with pickled garlic skins as well.

alexandria.text: The famous soup of the Nour Cafe in Alexandria is cooked with dried fig leaves and served in a cup of blue glass.
